finalText:
**Green. 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Only 3 cases were ever red. All in `order totals`. One bug caused all three.

`orderTotal` taxed the pre-discount amount. It computed tax on `cents`, not on `discounted`. Its own doc comment said otherwise. Rows with a zero discount or zero tax hid it.

Fix in [pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39). Now it reuses `applyTax` on the discounted base.
